name: Transaction Report Items 3
definition: Detailed description of the items that correspond to the parameters set in a request and for which a report has been generated.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.

EstablishedBaselineIdentification.name: Established Baseline Identification
EstablishedBaselineIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the baseline when it is established.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction by means of a code.

UserTransactionReference.name: User Transaction Reference
UserTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for each financial institution which is a party to the transaction.

PurchaseOrderReference.name: Purchase Order Reference
PurchaseOrderReference.definition: Reference to the purchase order of the underlying transaction.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that buys goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that sells goods or services, or a financial instrument.

ObligorBank.name: Obligor Bank
ObligorBank.definition: Financial institution that is an obligor bank to the transaction.

SubmittingBank.name: Submitting Bank
SubmittingBank.definition: Financial institution that is a data set submitting bank to the transaction.

OutstandingAmount.name: Outstanding Amount
OutstandingAmount.definition: Amount of baseline not yet utilised.

TotalNetAmount.name: Total Net Amount
TotalNetAmount.definition: Total net amount as specified in the baseline.
